capabilities.name: Create Signed and reputable policy
capabilities.targetDirection: Recommended and selected by default in the unified create-or-edit workflow.

capabilities.name: Create Windows-only policy
capabilities.targetDirection: Available as the restrictive built-in template in the unified create-or-edit workflow.

capabilities.name: Edit an existing XML policy
capabilities.targetDirection: Existing XML policies are another source in the unified create-or-edit workflow.

capabilities.name: Review and modify policy options
capabilities.targetDirection: Use one scope-based Policy behavior step with policy-scoped, device-wide, special-enforcement, platform-behavior, and compatibility sections. Default new policies to Audit and multiple-policy format, represent UMCI as an intent choice, preserve unknown content through delta-only edits, keep signing as a separate deployment-protection stage, and offer single-policy format only as an analyzed secondary export.
successorEvidence: AppControl.PolicyWizard.Core policy option catalog and lossless delta editor
Scope-based WinUI Policy behavior and semantic review steps

capabilities.name: Create and edit custom rules
capabilities.targetDirection: Use a source-driven candidate workspace with separate allow and deny policy intent, ranked rule identities, derived application/driver targeting, inventory-first folder analysis, semantic event clustering, nested signer exceptions, PFN-first packaged-app trust, specialized COM authorization, and a separate AppID tagging policy workflow. The production slice now implements a lossless rule graph, file and manual evidence, and real ConfigCI-backed PCA certificate, Publisher, and FilePublisher additions across OriginalFileName, InternalName, FileDescription, ProductName, PackageFamilyName, and FilePath selectors, plus file-attribute, path, and hash additions. Editing/removal, folders, events, packaged apps, exceptions, and COM remain to be migrated.
successorEvidence: AppControl.PolicyWizard.Core rule graph and file evidence candidate analyzer
ConfigCI-backed PCA certificate, Publisher, and FilePublisher candidate generation
Complete SpecificFileNameLevel candidate spectrum with strict fallback detection
Multi-EKU and CertOemID/OPUS preservation and parity coverage
Collision-safe signer fragment remapping and scenario merge

capabilities.name: Open an existing binary policy
capabilities.targetDirection: Treat binary conversion as an input adapter to the unified create-or-edit workflow.

capabilities.name: Create and edit supplemental policies
capabilities.targetDirection: Integrate supplemental policy creation and editing into the same source-based workflow.

capabilities.name: Merge App Control policies
capabilities.targetDirection: Provide policy merge as an explicit operation that produces a reviewable target policy.

capabilities.name: Create rules from event data
capabilities.targetDirection: Reintegrate local logs, EVTX, Advanced Hunting CSV, and Log Analytics CSV as evidence sources in Application rules. Normalize and semantically cluster observations before review, retain provenance, and never infer allow or deny intent from the event type.

capabilities.name: Signed installation, upgrade, and servicing
capabilities.targetDirection: Ship with an independent package identity and side-by-side servicing until legacy retirement.
successorEvidence: Development package identity and side-by-side launch

capabilities.name: Accessibility and localization readiness
capabilities.targetDirection: Make accessibility and localization acceptance criteria part of every migrated workflow.
successorEvidence: Accessible source cards and keyboard-addressable navigation
